pages.quiz:
CREATIVE ARTS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #20
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: CREATIVE ARTS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A rest is a sign for (1 mark)
   A. a repeat
   B. silence
   C. a song title
   D. the loudest sound

2. What is the main purpose of hand signs when singing? (1 mark)
   A. To keep flies away
   B. To show the pitch of the notes
   C. To count money
   D. To tell the time

3. In the frog jump, you should land (1 mark)
   A. softly with bent knees
   B. stiff
   C. on your back
   D. on your head

4. Who must do the burning when making charcoal sticks? (1 mark)
   A. Nobody
   B. Any learner
   C. The youngest learner
   D. An adult or the teacher

5. The battery of a camera (1 mark)
   A. keeps it dry
   B. cleans the lens
   C. takes the photo
   D. gives it power

6. Which is the lowest of the notes d, r and m? (1 mark)
   A. d
   B. m
   C. r
   D. They are all the same

7. The elephant walk is done by (1 mark)
   A. bending forward and letting your arms hang like a trunk
   B. running
   C. crawling
   D. jumping high

8. Funeral songs are usually (1 mark)
   A. fast and joyful
   B. loud only
   C. slow and sad
   D. about sports

9. Why do we shower before entering the pool? (1 mark)
   A. To get dry
   B. To keep the pool clean
   C. To learn to float
   D. To warm the water

10. The Kodaly hand sign for m is (1 mark)
   A. a wave
   B. a sloping palm
   C. a closed fist
   D. a flat palm held level

11. A balance in gymnastics is (1 mark)
   A. a fast run
   B. a position held still for a few seconds
   C. a throw
   D. a jump into water

12. Which is a good safety rule before playing netball? (1 mark)
   A. Play on broken ground
   B. Play with long sharp nails
   C. Wear a necklace
   D. Remove rings and bracelets

13. Which words describe how loud or soft a performance was? (1 mark)
   A. Pitch
   B. Dynamics
   C. Diction
   D. Tempo

14. A photograph is also called a (1 mark)
   A. stave
   B. drum
   C. photo
   D. montage

15. The screen of a camera (1 mark)
   A. makes sound
   B. shows what you will photograph and photos you have taken
   C. is the strap
   D. is the battery

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. Describe how to make a montage on ball games. (4 marks)

17. Give four safety rules when making charcoal sticks. (4 marks)

18. Explain how to make a slab and a coil from clay. (3 marks)

19. Why should the flag stick be held high while cheering? (2 marks)

20. Name two animal movement games. (2 marks)
pages.answers:
CREATIVE ARTS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #20 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. B — silence
   A rest tells the performer to stay silent for a time.

2. B — To show the pitch of the notes
   Hand signs help singers see and remember how high a note is.

3. A — softly with bent knees
   Bent knees absorb the shock.

4. D — An adult or the teacher
   Fire is dangerous, so only an adult does the burning.

5. D — gives it power
   Without power the device will not work.

6. A — d
   Doh is the lowest of the three.

7. A — bending forward and letting your arms hang like a trunk
   Slow heavy steps with arms as a trunk.

8. C — slow and sad
   They comfort families and remember the person.

9. B — To keep the pool clean
   It removes dirt and sweat.

10. D — a flat palm held level
   Me is shown with a flat, level hand.

11. B — a position held still for a few seconds
   A balance is a still position that you hold under control.

12. D — Remove rings and bracelets
   Jewellery can hurt you and others.

13. B — Dynamics
   Dynamics are loud and soft.

14. C — photo
   Photo is short for photograph.

15. B — shows what you will photograph and photos you have taken
   The screen displays the view and the saved pictures.

SECTION B
----
16. (4 marks)
   Answer: Collect and cut pictures of ball games from old papers. Arrange them on a background without gluing, overlapping the pieces. Paste the back ones first and then the others. Add a title and let it dry.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each step.

17. (4 marks)
   Answer: An adult does the burning; keep far from the fire; leave the tin closed until cold; collect only dead twigs; wash hands afterwards. Any four.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct rule.

18. (3 marks)
   Answer: Flatten the clay with a rolling pin until even for a slab. Roll a small piece between palms for a coil.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the slab, 1 mark for the coil, 1 mark for even thickness.

19. (2 marks)
   Answer: So it does not hit other people, and so the flag can be seen.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each reason.

20. (2 marks)
   Answer: Frog jump, crab walk, elephant walk, snake slither, hare hop, crocodile crawl, giraffe stretch, monkey swing. Any two.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.
